learning_outcomes.text: Acquaintance with the specific mechanisms of fine mechanics used in instruments, their application, main characteristics, and specificity of the choice of drive.
Ability to analyze the properties of mechanisms.
Ability to design instruments by calculations based on geometrical, kinematical, static and dynamical considerations.

syllabus_topics: General questions of the structure and design of instruments
Elements of instruments with continuous and discontinuous operation
teaching_methods: Solving practical problems in laboratory classes
assessment_rules: The final mark is based on the course assignment mark (40% of the final mark) and the mark of two tests (60% of the final mark). Assessment is continuous, and the exam type is written.
degree: Computer Aided Design in Mechanical and Instrument Engineering (Bachelor)
academic_year: Paquete ECTS de la FMME (datos 2008/09-posteriores; ver notas)
